'''Trophies''' are [[items]] dropped by defeated [[creatures]] and can stack to 20. == Usage == All trophies have some shared uses: * They can be attached to [[Item Stand]]s to serve as decorations. * They can be used to program the [[Ballista]]. * All trophies will give 1 [[Coal]] per trophy if used in an [[Obliterator]]. Some trophies have special usage: * Some are used as [[crafting]] ingredients. * Some are used to summon [[Forsaken]]. Each Forsaken is guaranteed to drop a special trophy when defeated that can be returned to the [[Sacrificial Stones]] to unlock a new [[Forsaken power]]. == List of trophies == === Meadows === {| class="wikitable" !
